# Villa Property Management

> > Villa Property Management offers locally-owned apartment and office rentals across Portland metro, specializing in vintage and modern properties in NW Portland, Beaverton, Lake Oswego, and surrounding areas.

Villa Property Management operates distinctive rental communities including vintage 1920s buildings in Portland's Alphabet District (Whitestone, Flanders, Northrup), modern complexes like Roxclif and Kruse Villa, and office spaces in Beaverton. Properties range from studio to 3-bedroom units with many cat-friendly options.
